title: Is a Private Boat Trip a Good Idea for a Family of Five in Madeira?
description: Yes: five is exactly the boat's limit, so the whole family fits alone. Priced per boat, the 2h30 Day Trip works out at 100 EUR each, with a bathroom on board.
heroAlt: A family of five seen from behind on the boat deck, heading towards Ribeira Brava
keywords: private boat trip for a family of five madeira
how many people on a private boat madeira
private boat price per person family

images.prompt: Late morning off Ribeira Brava on Madeira's south coast. Photographed from the stern of a white 9 metre motor boat with grey cushioned seats and a dark canopy, looking forward along the deck. A family of five sits on the cushioned seats, all seen from behind: two adults and three children of clearly different heights, wet hair, towels round their shoulders, all looking ahead at the coast. Ahead, the small town of Ribeira Brava with its church tower at the mouth of a green valley, calm deep blue water, bright sun, true colours. No faces visible, no text.
images.alt: A family of five seen from behind on the boat deck, heading towards Ribeira Brava
